subject: Compliance tooling re-eval: shortlist & procurement plan
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Compliance tooling re-eval: shortlist & procurement plan

Team —

Our current subscription with TrustCenter (platform + trust portal) comes up for renewal in June. Rather than a straight renewal I want us to re-evaluate options (TrustCenter add-on vs Vanta vs Drata) to make sure we’re optimizing for reliability and total cost. High-level asks: 

- Marcus: quick tech/ops comparison (integration lift, SSO, evidence automation).
- Laura: legal/procurement risk checklist + contract must-haves (data residency, audit rights).
- Aditya: finance view on TCO and negotiation levers.

I’ve attached the procurement checklist and a rough timeline. Can you each send a short recommendation by EOD Friday (20th)? I’ll then request quotes from vendors and schedule a decision meeting for the last week of March.

Thanks —
Steph
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: procurement-checklist.xlsx
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 11:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance tooling re-eval: shortlist & procurement plan

Steph —

Quick notes after looking at integration and ops effort: 

- TrustCenter: lowest integration lift; already sends SIEM/asset data to portal, good for evidence aggregation. Limited built-in remediation playbooks.
- Vanta: mature automation for PR and infra evidence, slightly heavier onboarding with infra agents; faster SOC2 evidence collection for infra controls.
- Drata: good UI and policy mapping, pricing is competitive at scale but needs more manual mapping for a couple of our custom services.

Recommendation: If the priority is minimum operational overhead and fastest time to green, TrustCenter is still a good fit. If we want more automation (and are willing to invest onboarding), Vanta edges out on collection automation.

I’ll pull together estimated engineering hours for each option and attach a short matrix by EOD.

—Marcus
Sr. Engineering Manager, Platform

Attachments: integration-effort-matrix.xlsx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance tooling re-eval: shortlist & procurement plan

Thanks — a few legal/procurement points to flag before we talk to vendors: 

1) Data access & residency: require explicit clauses for how vendor handles customer metadata and logs; for TrustCenter we should confirm where backups are hosted.
2) Audit scope & evidence export: insist on machine-readable evidence export (not just screenshots) and 30-day access to raw evidence for audits.
3) Subprocessor list + notification SLA: must be provided and kept current.
4) Termination & transition: require a handover SOW with evidence export within 15 days at termination.

I drafted a short addendum we can push in negotiations (attached) — happy to iterate.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security

Attachments: vendor-contract-addendum-template.docx
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Park <alex@trustcenter.io>, Sara Bloom <sara@vanta.com>, Marco Ruiz <sales@drata.io>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Mar 2026 14:20:00 -0700
Subject: RFQ: updated scope & timeline request (TrustCenter / Vanta / Drata)

Hi Alex / Sara / Marco —

Redwood is re-evaluating compliance tooling ahead of our June renewal window. Please provide the following by EOD Thu (25 Mar):

1) Updated quote for enterprise plan (include seat/asset model) and any volume discounts.
2) Typical onboarding timeline and high-level onboarding plan (steps, owners, expected SRE/infra hours).
3) Evidence export capabilities (format & retention) and SOC 2 automation features.
4) Any new features you expect to ship in the next 6 months relevant to evidence automation or incident correlation.

CC’d are our engineering lead (Marcus), legal (Laura) and finance (Aditya) — they may follow up with a few clarifying Qs. If you have a standard SOW/SLA/PO template please attach.

Thanks — looking forward to the quotes.

Regards,
Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Alex Park <alex@trustcenter.io>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RFQ: updated scope & timeline request (TrustCenter / Vanta / Drata)

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks for the RFQ. Attaching our updated quote and onboarding outline. High level:
- Price: enterprise plan $38k/year with full trust portal + audit exports; 10% discount offered if bundling multi-year (2+ years).
- Onboarding: typical 3 week timeline with one integration engineer + two weekly syncs; estimated infra hours: ~30-40 for out-of-the-box connectors, additional for custom tooling.
- Evidence export: JSON/CSV export available via admin API; we can provide 90 days raw evidence retention and archive exports on request.
- New features: automated anomaly detection for evidence gaps launching Q3.

Attaching: trustcenter-quote-2026-03.pdf and onboarding-outline.docx. Happy to set a 30 minute demo next week.

Best,
Alex Park
Head of Customer Success, TrustCenter

Attachments: trustcenter-quote-2026-03.pdf, onboarding-outline.docx
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Mar 2026 10:55:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance tooling re-eval: shortlist & procurement plan

Looping in finance viewpoint —

- The TrustCenter quote looks reasonable vs. status quo, but we should push for: 1) a better onboarding credit, 2) multi-year pricing with fixed escalator, 3) a 60-90 day SLA credit for missed evidence exports.
- If Vanta can shave 20% off listed price, their higher automation could pay for itself in 6–9 months.

Suggested negotiation levers to ask vendors: onboarding credit, implementation hours discount, guaranteed machine-readable export format in contract, and a defined rollback/transition SOW.

I can draft an LOI and typical PO terms once we pick a primary vendor to negotiate with.

—Aditya
Finance Lead, Revenue Operations
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Mar 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance tooling re-eval: shortlist & procurement plan

Thanks everyone — quick summary and next steps: 

- Received TrustCenter quote (attached). Waiting on Vanta and Drata quotes (reminders sent).
- Action items: Marcus to finalize engineering hours matrix (by Mon 29th); Laura to finalize addendum language; Aditya to prepare draft LOI/PO language.
- Decision meeting scheduled: Mon, 30 Mar 2026 10:00 AM PT — invite attached. Please treat this as the meeting to pick primary vendor and fallback.
- Procure ID created: PROC-2026-0423 (use this on any quotes/invoices).

If any vendor responses come in before Monday, please drop them into the PR-2026-0423 drive folder.

Cheers —
Steph
